title: Rule 09 — Past without a huge verb chart
short: Learn the most useful past forms as pairs.
syntax:
ich habe + gearbeitet/gemacht/gekauft
ich bin + gegangen/gekommen/gefahren
body: Spoken German usually uses Perfekt for past events. Use haben with many verbs, and sein with a number of motion/change-of-state verbs. “ich war” and “ich hatte” are also very common.
pitfall: Do not generalize haben to every verb: “Ich bin gegangen” is correct.
